1.title: Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll Resigns as U.S. Military Grapples With Two Wars
1.summary: The resignation of Daniel P. Driscoll, the secretary of the Army, had been expected but comes at a tumultuous time for the service.

2.title: JD Vance Called Michigan Senate Candidate Abdul El-Sayed ‘Evil’ in Speech
2.summary: Vice President JD Vance also told Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, Michigan’s Democratic Senate nominee, to “keep my wife’s name out of your mouth.”

3.title: Wendell Berry, Writer Who Extolled America’s Agrarian Past, Dies at 92
3.summary: A Kentucky farmer, he railed against agribusiness and championed small family farms and the environment, winning widespread acclaim.

4.title: US Supreme Court clears way for Trump to keep building White House ballroom
4.summary: But Chief Justice John Roberts dissents, writing that "construction is likely unlawful".

5.title: ‘The Nest of Snakes’: Warring Cartels Target Women in Mexico
5.summary: A two-year war between rival Sinaloa Cartel factions is driving a surge in killings and disappearances targeting women.

6.title: Lionel Messi’s Retirement From Soccer Sparks Heartbreak Across Argentina
6.summary: Lionel Messi’s retirement from the national soccer team, though widely expected, sparked fears of a diminished squad, and heartbreak over the departure of a national icon.
